Cleanses

    • 3-Day Recharge: Reignite your health and energy.

Results You Can Feel:
Boosted energy, radiant skin, improved digestion, and a lighter, healthier you. Start your cleanse journey today and experience the GRIFFYS difference. Every Cleanse comes with a free one on one consult with our in house nutrition expert.

Wild Crafted Sea Moss Gel

Nature’s Ultimate Superfood – GRIFFYS Sea Moss Gel
Elevate your health with our all-natural, wild crafted sea moss gel, harvested straight from pristine volcanic mineral rich waters of Saint Vincent. Packed with 92 of the 102 essential minerals your body needs, this versatile superfood is your secret weapon for optimal wellness.

  • Health Benefits:

    • Supports immunity and gut health.
    • Thyroid Health
    • Enhances energy, endurance, and recovery.
    • Promotes glowing skin, healthy hair, and strong nails.

  • How to Use:
    Add to smoothies, teas, or recipes for a nutrient boost, or take it straight by the spoonful for maximum impact.

Why Choose GRIFFYS Sea Moss Gel?
Made with care, our gel is always fresh, wild crafted, and free from additives. Your health deserves nothing less than the best.

What is Griffy's Organics?

• Brand introduction: 

At Griffy's Organics, we’re on a mission to redefine wellness by delivering high-quality, accessible nourishment that fuels both the body and soul. Rooted in integrity and innovation, our offerings are crafted with care to provide nutrient-rich, sustainable solutions for modern living. From our raw cold-pressed juices to our sea moss gels, every product is a celebration of nature’s finest ingredients and the power of real, unprocessed nutrition.

With our core values—People First, Move With Integrity, Nutrition Innovation, Each One, Teach One, & Win Baby, Win —we aim to inspire a healthier lifestyle for our community. GRIFFYS isn’t just a brand; it’s a movement to empower people to take charge of their health while fostering meaningful connections. Whether you’re grabbing a quick juice or exploring our nutrient desnse options, we’re here to support your journey toward holistic wellness.
